# 1 Clement Chapter 60 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 60 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_060_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 60

*[The Great Prayer — Part II: Intercession for Rulers and All Humanity]*

**60:1** *For you have revealed the eternal order of the world*
*through the things you have made.*
*You, LORD, created the earth.*
*Faithful through every generation;*
*righteous in your judgments;*
*wonderful in your power and majesty;*
*wise in creating;*
*discerning in establishing all that exists;*
*good in all that can be seen;*
*trustworthy to all who trust in you —*
*merciful and compassionate —*
*forgive us our sins and our wrongs,*
*our transgressions and our failures.*

**60:2** *Do not count every sin against your servants and handmaids,*
*but purify us with the cleansing of your truth.*
*Guide our steps to walk in holiness of heart,*
*to do what is good and pleasing*
*before you and before our rulers.*

**60:3** *Yes, Lord — let your face shine on us with goodness, in peace.*
*Let your mighty hand be our shelter.*
*Let your uplifted arm protect us from every sin.*
*Deliver us from those who hate us without cause.*

**60:4** *Give harmony and peace*
*to us and to all who live on the earth,*
*as you gave it to our ancestors when they called on you*
*in faith and in truth —*
*that we may be saved*
*as we submit to your all-powerful and glorious name,*
*and to our rulers and governors on the earth.*

---

*PNEUMA renders chs. 59–61 as liturgical poetry in honor of their character as the earliest substantial Christian prayer outside the New Testament.*
